qtyDecision.QTY_ZERO_COMPLETE_IMPLEMENTATION: NO. Measured on the integrated candidate: no layer removes a qty=0 packing row. recipeBomEngine applies `qty: Number(part.qty || 1)`, dynamicCostPreview.buildPackingSnapshotParts applies `qty: Number(part.qty || 1)`, and calculatePackingPartsCost applies `Number(part.qty || 1)`. An accepted qty=0 therefore survives as qty 1.
qtyDecision.QTY_ZERO_END_TO_END_EFFECT: NONE. Probe: packingParts=[{model:'木箱', qty:0}, {model:'珍珠棉', qty:1}] through buildRecipeBomDraft produced [{'木箱', qty 1}, {'珍珠棉', qty 1}] - the qty=0 row was neither removed nor zeroed, it became qty 1.
qtyDecision.MASTER_QTY_POLICY: REJECT qty=0 - configuredRecipeSnapshot.normalizePackingPartsOverride used parsePositiveNumber ('qty 必须是正数'). Measured by swapping master's configuredRecipeSnapshot.cjs in place.
qtyDecision.NATIVE_QTY_POLICY: ACCEPT qty=0 and preserve it - parseNonNegativeNumber.
qtyDecision.FINAL_QTY_POLICY: REJECT qty=0 (production semantics restored). api/services/configuredRecipeSnapshot.cjs is back to parsePositiveNumber; the file differs from production master only by an explanatory comment. Verified by diff against master: the only delta is the comment block.
qtyDecision.rationale: Accepting an instruction the system does not carry out is worse than rejecting it. No formal business implementation of '0 = remove role' exists, so this integration ticket must not open a half-implemented feature.
qtyDecision.QTY_DOCUMENTATION_CORRECTED: NO - not yet. docs/api-reference.md still contains the current-tense claim '空数组清空包装，qty=0 移除对应角色' for POST /api/recipes/bom-draft. That sentence is present on PRODUCTION MASTER, so it is a pre-existing false claim about current capability, not something this integration introduced. Correcting it touches a hash-attested handoff artifact, so it is left as an explicit open item rather than edited silently at the end of this round.
qtyDecision.QTY_FUTURE_GAP_RECORDED: PARTIALLY - recorded here in the integration evidence. It is NOT yet recorded in docs/technical-debt.md.
qtyDecision.gapStatement: DESIRED/FUTURE, NOT CURRENTLY SUPPORTED: 'qty=0 removes the corresponding packing role' is unimplemented in recipeBomEngine, dynamicCostPreview and costEngine. packingRemovalPolicy is only partially effective: its CLEAR_ALL branch (packingParts=[], allowClearAll) IS reachable and enforced, while its qty=0 REMOVE branch can only be reached through paths that do not perform the removal.
qtyDecision.FINAL_QTY_BEHAVIOR: qty must be > 0; qty=0, negative and non-numeric are rejected; null/undefined/'' fall back to the default 1

PRICE_CONTRACT_SOURCES: schema: api/database/schema.cjs parts table -> `price REAL DEFAULT 0` plus `CHECK(price IS NULL OR price >= 0)`. Zero is the column DEFAULT and a negative price is rejected by the database itself.

formal parts API: api/services/partCommands.cjs lines 161, 510, 1217 all validate with parseNonNegativeNumber, i.e. price >= 0 is legal and price < 0 is illegal, for create, update and batch_update_prices.

formal list filter: api/services/partQueries.cjs line 59 normalizeOptionalNumber(input.priceAbove, 'priceAbove', { min: 0 }) - the price-filter lower bound IS 0, so a zero-priced part is ordinary searchable catalogue data.
documentation: docs/api-reference.md uses missingParts for the unpriced case, and 0 is a normal stored catalogue value.

existing tests: no production test asserts that a zero catalogue price must be treated as missing; production tests only assert missingParts for a genuinely absent catalogue entry or a cable with no metre price.
priceValidity.CAN_A_FORMAL_PRICE_BE_ZERO: YES. Zero is a legal catalogue price meaning a genuine zero-cost item; it is NOT a synonym for unpriced.
priceValidity.PRICE_POSITIVE_POLICY: VALID_PRICE - contributes price x qty, not in missingParts, source 精确匹配 or 型号回退(取最低价)
priceValidity.PRICE_ZERO_POLICY: VALID_PRICE (LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY included) - contributes 0, NOT in missingParts, source 精确匹配. This restores the master-equivalent outcome: a zero-priced catalogue part yields total 0 with missingParts [].
priceValidity.PRICE_NULL_POLICY: MISSING_PRICE - catalogue row exists but carries no price; contributes 0 and IS reported in missingParts so current cost reports incomplete
priceValidity.PRICE_NAN_POLICY: INVALID_DATA - a non-numeric catalogue price is not usable; contributes 0 and IS reported in missingParts
priceValidity.PRICE_NEGATIVE_POLICY: INVALID_DATA - rejected by the database constraint and by the formal parts API; contributes 0 and IS reported in missingParts. Master instead produced a NEGATIVE total.
priceValidity.MASTER_PRICE_POLICY: any value taken as-is: 0 accepted silently, negative produced a negative total, null/undefined/non-numeric produced NaN in the detail price and NaN in the total
priceValidity.NATIVE_PRICE_POLICY: every non-finite or non-positive value treated as an unusable price
priceValidity.FINAL_PRICE_POLICY: positive and zero are usable prices; null, undefined, non-numeric and negative are not. Implemented as hasUsableCatalogPrice() / catalogPriceSourceLabel() in api/services/costEngine.cjs with the formal evidence in the comment. The supplier fallback now picks the lowest USABLE price instead of letting a missing/invalid row win the minimum.
BEHAVIOR_DELTA_VS_MASTER: zero price: NO CHANGE - master and the final candidate both accept it and both report missingParts []
negative price: master produced a negative total, final candidate contributes 0 and reports the part as 价格无效
null / undefined / non-numeric price: master produced NaN in detail price and NaN in the total, final candidate contributes 0 and reports the part as 未定价
supplier fallback: master could select a row with a missing price as the minimum, final candidate selects the lowest usable price
priceValidity.FORMAL_BUSINESS_SEMANTICS_PRESERVED: YES - the only changes are to malformed-data handling, and zero-price behaviour is byte-equivalent to production
priceValidity.MISSING_PARTS_SEMANTICS: missingParts is the existing formal channel (currentRecipeCost derives costComplete from missingParts.length === 0, and the warning text is '当前成本不完整，N 个 BOM 型号缺少价格'); the final candidate only routes genuinely unusable prices into it
priceValidity.PARTIAL_COST_SEMANTICS: unchanged - partialTotalCost is still returned, currentTotalCost stays null while incomplete, and the existing warnings text is preserved

residualRedTest.test: tests/recipeScenarioComparison.test.cjs:489 - N4.1C-R3：缺少正式包装价格时情景金额和差额均不伪造为零
residualRedTest.npmTestState: 2991 total, 2990 pass, 1 fail - this test is the only failure
residualRedTest.whatItAsserts: a packing part whose formal catalogue row has price NULL must yield cost.complete=false, currentTotalCost=null and an INCOMPLETE comparison
residualRedTest.whatHappensNow: cost.complete=true, missingParts=[] - the NULL catalogue price is read as a valid zero price, which under the formal contract above IS a valid price, so the part is not reported as unpriced
residualRedTest.rootCauseNarrowed: some layer still coerces a NULL catalogue price to 0 before calculateRecipeCost sees it, so the final rule never observes the NULL. Two obvious conversion sites are already eliminated in this round: recipeBomEngine's packing row (was `Number(matchedPart.price || 0)`) and dynamicCostPreview.buildPackingSnapshotParts (was `Number(matched?.price || 0)`); both now omit snapshotPrice when the catalogue price is unusable. The remaining conversion is inside the cost-basis data flow and was NOT located before this round ended - the instrumented runs that would have identified it did not fire, which means it must be isolated with a dedicated trace rather than a guess.
residualRedTest.whyNotFixedBlindly: the two candidate fixes (a) threading an explicit unpriced marker through the cost basis, or (b) rejecting a zero price again, are opposite policies and the second would contradict the formal evidence above. Choosing either under time pressure inside an integration ticket is exactly the silent cost-policy decision the Supervisor prohibited.
residualRedTest.classification: OPEN - needs one dedicated trace plus a policy-consistent fix, then this test goes green
residualRedTest.notWeakened: the test was NOT edited, skipped or relaxed
